widget.title: Attendance
widget.autoClockedIn: Clocked you in because you started work
widget.autoUndoHint: If this is wrong, you can undo it now.

my.empty: No records yet. They will appear once you start work.
my.autoClosedHint: Closed automatically because clock-out was never pressed. Ask an admin to correct it.

leave.grantHint: Use a negative number to correct. Grants are appended, never overwritten.

settings.autoClockIn: Clock in when I start work
settings.autoClockInHint: If you start a task in Q Task and have no record today, you are clocked in automatically.

error.not_working: You are not working right now.
error.not_on_break: You are not on a break.
error.overlapping_leave: You already have leave requested for these dates.
error.already_started: Leave that has already started can only be canceled by an admin.
error.generic: Could not complete. Please try again.
error.fix_reason_required: Please enter a reason for the correction.
error.timeline_must_start_with_clock_in: A clock-in time is required — the corrected record must start with one.

stats.title: Team stats
stats.overtimeHint: ‘Over baseline’ totals time past each person's daily baseline. With flexible hours some days run over and others under — this is not a legal overtime figure.

fix.title: Correct attendance
fix.appendOnlyHint: Nothing is erased. Correct the times below; the originals stay as history and the totals are recalculated.
fix.reasonPlaceholder: e.g. Forgot to clock out; correcting to actual time
fix.timelineHint: What you leave here becomes the record for this day. Fix or remove wrong times — the originals are kept as history.

admin.desc: Approve leave, see team status, and review monthly stats. Your own clock-in and leave requests live under “Attendance” on the left.

correct.title: Correct attendance
correct.reasonPh: e.g. I left right after the meeting but auto clock-out closed later
correct.notice: Applied immediately. The original record is kept as history and managers are notified.
